intro: Prague's spires, Kafka's stories, Dvořák's music and the word 'robot' all come from the Czech lands.

chapters.title: Writers and composers
text: Franz Kafka wrote his strange, unsettling stories in Prague, and the Czech writer Karel Čapek introduced the word 'robot' in a 1920 play. Antonín Dvořák wrote the New World Symphony, and Alfons Mucha's posters defined Art Nouveau.

chapters.title: Prague and puppets
text: Prague's astronomical clock, installed in 1410, is the oldest astronomical clock still working. Puppet theatre is a beloved Czech tradition, and the cartoon Little Mole (Krtek) has charmed children worldwide.
